member.name: T:Thermo.Chromeleon.Sdk.Addins.Workflow.IWorkflowEndCommand
member.summary: Will be executed when the eWorkflow wizard completes. The add-in developer has access to the created sequence before and after the commit.
member.remarks: Please note it is not allowed to have multiple extensions for this extension point.

member.name: M:Thermo.Chromeleon.Sdk.Addins.Workflow.IWorkflowEndCommand.BeforeCommit(Thermo.Chromeleon.Sdk.Addins.Workflow.IWizardRunContext,Thermo.Chromeleon.Sdk.Interfaces.Data.ISequence)
member.summary: This method offers an SDK developer to modify the sequence which was created during an eWorkflow wizard run. The sequence is not yet committed in the data base. Furthermore it is not required to create a in order to modify the sequence item because the caller already opened one. In addition the caller will also handle the transaction completion.
member.remarks: The sequence can not be modified in a new thread because the item already contains modifications and belongs to the caller thread (which is normally the UI thread)

member.name: M:Thermo.Chromeleon.Sdk.Addins.Workflow.IWorkflowEndCommand.AfterCommit(Thermo.Chromeleon.Sdk.Addins.Workflow.IWizardRunContext,System.Uri)
member.summary: This method offers an SDK developer to access the sequence which was created during the eWorkflow run. The sequence is already committed. Please see in order to access the sequence item before the transaction completion. If there was an error during the save operation of the sequence (transaction completion), the method will NOT be called.
